answer: A concrete approach: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The haven of work and the knoll of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a dawn to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
